title: The ship needs an agreement
lines: A ship can cross an ocean only after people learn how to share its risks.
The History and Future of Social Technologies explores the agreements that make material inventions possible.

title: The inventions between people
lines: Contracts, money, records, and public rules let strangers coordinate across distances no individual relationship can span.
The book follows this less visible machinery from early communities toward institutions shaped by digital systems.
